selected-fill.roleHint: Selected row on the page; a tonal step, no shadow. Light: sand. In the sand drafts column the selected row uses the segment colour instead.

fill-on-surface.roleHint: Fields, quiet buttons and the segmented track inside the white settings panel. Light: sand; dark: strong sand.

night-selected-fill.roleHint: Selected row in the dark scheme (the selected-segment step).

night-fill-on-surface.roleHint: Fill on Surface in the dark scheme (strong surface).

year-night-selected-fill.roleHint: Selected row in the yearly palette, dark scheme.

device-bezel.roleHint: Phone frame bezel ring and cutout only; device hardware, never a UI colour.

on-masthead-2.roleHint: Resting links in the admin sidebar, on navy.

masthead-chip.roleHint: Ghost-on-masthead fills, the admin sidebar current link and hover (at 60%), the rule above the sidebar foot group. 10% in dark.

display.purpose: Masthead title on every tab root.

display-year.purpose: Masthead title under the 2026 yearly palette only.

prose.purpose: Welcome letter and descriptions, max 65ch, ink-2.

micro.purpose: Tab-bar labels, unread badge, day-rail weekdays; uppercase admin sidebar group labels and office-week weekdays.

pill.purpose: Pills, admin sidebar count capsules, office-week capsule dates.

code.purpose: Permission nodes and patterns in the admin developer roles tool only.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Boxed lists and the event feature card only (light scheme).

shadows.name: lift-dark
shadows.purpose: The same lift in the dark scheme.

shadows.name: segment
shadows.purpose: Selected segment of the segmented control.

shadows.name: play-overlay
shadows.purpose: Round play button over a video hero.

shadows.name: badge-ring
shadows.purpose: Separates the unread badge from the bell.

shadows.name: frosted-bar
shadows.value: backdrop-filter: saturate(1.6) blur(18px); background: 90% page colour; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--line)
shadows.purpose: Section tabs (tab bar uses saturate(1.8) blur(20px) and a top hairline).

shadows.name: device-frame
shadows.purpose: The phone frame: a 9px bezel ring drawn as a spread, then the lift.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single curve for presses, sheets, the section-tab underline and page entry.

motion.name: paged-turn
motion.purpose: A paged sheet's cover and body on a page change only; never on first open.

motion.name: page-dot
motion.value: 240ms ease-out, width 8px to 20px and line to orange
motion.purpose: The current page dot widening to a capsule.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, in the app and the admin panel alike (the admin panel collapses every transition too).

motion.name: sidebar-marker
motion.purpose: Admin sidebar current-page bar (scaleX as an underline at 900px and under).

motion.name: admin-hover
motion.value: 160ms background-color and color, ease-out (120ms for table rows)
motion.purpose: Admin sidebar links, filter chips, area rows, table rows.

motion.name: sort-arrow
motion.purpose: Data-table sort arrow appearing on hover.

breakpoints.name: admin-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Admin sidebar becomes a top strip; marker becomes an underline.

breakpoints.name: admin-office-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Office week columns stack; the seven-day rail scrolls sideways (days at least 84px); the announcements desk drops its proof under the writing column (980px work area + 248px sidebar).

breakpoints.name: admin-access-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Access page stacks its role column above the place.

breakpoints.name: admin-workbench-two-pane
breakpoints.purpose: Workbench detail drops under the work area.

breakpoints.name: split-view-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Split-view detail drops beneath the list (shared component, window width).

breakpoints.name: split-view-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Admin split-view detail narrows to 300 to 360px.

breakpoints.name: table-optional-columns
breakpoints.purpose: Optional table columns hide when the split-view list is narrower.

breakpoints.name: sheet-centred
breakpoints.purpose: Sheets centre on the screen; a sheet without a cover hides its grabber.

themes.default: light scheme, brand palette; Appearance setting defaults to Automatic (follows the system)
themes.year: 2026 yearly palette, under comparison with the brand palette; swaps greens and a DM Serif Text masthead title

extensions.rootType: html font: -apple-system-body when supported, else 17px; all sizes in rem

deviceGeometry.purpose: Phone frame hardware shapes; not part of the radius scale and never used on UI boxes.

dayRail.purpose: The shared office-week rail (DayRail): a week on the admin home page, a fortnight on Announcements.
dayRail.week: 7 days from today; columns minmax(0,1fr), at least 84px and scrolling sideways at 1228px and under.
dayRail.fortnight: 14 days from this week's Monday; columns at least 56px, 6px gap, 8px 8px 10px day padding, capsules 5px 7px in pill type; scrolls sideways when the days don't fit.
dayRail.packing: each capsule takes the highest band where it doesn't touch another
dayRail.moment: a span whose end equals its start reserves its day and the next two (clipped at the rail's end), shows a two-line title and the time alone

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 22px; font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 140ms; background: var(--sand, #f4efe7); color: var(--ink, #18233a); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--sand-strong, #e9e1d4); } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00776d); outline-offset: 2px; }

} .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00776d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-badge { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 5px; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 9px; } .ds-status-text strong { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 22px; font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 140ms; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 14px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00776d); components.name: Section tabs
components.description: Sticky section navigation under the masthead with the sliding orange underline.
components.css: .ds-section-tabs { display: flex; gap: 18px; padding: 0 20px; overflow-x: auto; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.6) blur(18px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--line, rgb(42 61 94 / 0.12)); font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-section-tabs button { position: relative; flex: none; padding: 14px 0 12px; border: 0; background: none; font: inherit; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-3, #6b7384); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-section-tabs button:hover, .ds-section-tabs button.on { color: var(--ink, #18233a); } .ds-section-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00776d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-section-tabs i { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--marker, #e7ae74); transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); }

components.name: List rows
components.description: Hairline-divided rows: leading tile, title and caption, trailing chevron; an unread row has a 9px marker dot in a 17px gutter and a 700 title, a read row a 500 title.
components.html: Service timesSunday 9:00, 10:30 and 6:00Home screen draft to checkAdvent tiles are ready for a look.Preview it
components.css: .ds-list { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(42 61 94 / 0.12)); font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(42 61 94 / 0.12)); color: var(--ink-3, #6b7384); text-decoration: none; transition: background 120ms; } .ds-row:hover, .ds-row:active { background: var(--line, rgb(42 61 94 / 0.12)); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00776d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--sand, #f4efe7); color: var(--primary, #2a3d5e); flex: none; } .ds-row-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-title { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--ink, #18233a); } .ds-row-title.ds-unread { font-weight: 700; } .ds-row-sub { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ink-2, #545e70); } .ds-row-icon--warm { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--marker, #e7ae74) 30%, transparent); color: var(--marker-ink, #8a5422); } .ds-row-title.ds-unread { position: relative; padding-left: 17px; } .ds-dot { position: absolute; top: 0.42em; left: 0; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--marker, #e7ae74); } .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--accent, #00776d); font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Passage chips and pill
components.description: Bible passage capsules under sermon outline points, and the pill in its Marker, Accent and Quiet tones.
components.html: Later releaseTestExpired
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center; font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-passage { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--sand, #f4efe7); color: var(--accent, #00776d); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, transform 140ms; } .ds-passage:hover { background: var(--sand-strong, #e9e1d4); } .ds-passage:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-passage:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00776d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--marker, #e7ae74) 28%, transparent); color: var(--marker-ink, #8a5422); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-pill--accent { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--live, #009c8f) 16%, transparent); color: var(--accent, #00776d); } .ds-pill--quiet { background: var(--fill-on-surface, #f4efe7); color: var(--ink-2, #545e70); }

components.name: Filter chips
components.description: Sand capsules; the selected one turns navy.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter button { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 18px; background: var(--sand, #f4efe7); color: var(--ink-2, #545e70); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-filter button:hover { color: var(--ink, #18233a); } .ds-filter button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--primary, #2a3d5e); color: #fff; } .ds-filter button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00776d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Borderless sand field with a caption label and an inset aqua focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2, #545e70); } .ds-field textarea { min-height: 96px; padding: 13px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--sand, #f4efe7); color: var(--ink, #18233a); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; resize: vertical; caret-color: var(--accent, #00776d); } .ds-field textarea::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #6b7384); } .ds-field textarea:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--accent, #00776d); }

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: Sand track of equal segments; the selected one is a white tile with the segment shadow; a segment can carry an orange count.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; padding: 3px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--sand, #f4efe7); font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #545e70); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms, color 180ms; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink, #18233a); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #18233a); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00776d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-seg__count { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--marker, #e7ae74) 30%, transparent); color: var(--marker-ink, #8a5422); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-seg + .ds-seg { margin-top: 10px; }

components.name: Tab bar
components.description: Five-tab bar; the active tab is deep aqua.
components.html: SundayWeekListenPrayerMore
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); padding: 6px 4px 8px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.8) blur(20px); box-shadow: 0 -0.5px 0 var(--line, rgb(42 61 94 / 0.12)); font-family: "Montserrat", -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tabbar a { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; min-height: 48px; justify-content: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-3, #6b7384); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-tabbar a:hover { color: var(--ink, #18233a); } .ds-tabbar a.on { color: var(--accent, #00776d); } .ds-tabbar a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #00776d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tabbar a:active svg { transform: scale(0.88); } .ds-tabbar svg { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); }

components.name: Tab strip with counts
components.description: Static tabs over a hairline; the selected tab is ink with the 3px orange underline, and a tab may carry a count.
components.css: .ds-tab-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-tab-strip button { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink-3); font: inherit; font-size: var(--text-label); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-strip button:hover { color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-tab-strip button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-strip button[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ink); } .ds-tab-strip button[aria-selected="true"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--marker); } .ds-count { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--marker) 30%, transparent); color: var(--marker-ink); font-size: var(--text-pill); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Selected row
components.description: The chosen row in a list: a tonal step widened into the gutter, no shadow.

components.css: .ds-rows { padding: 0 12px; background: var(--page); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-row { display: grid; min-height: 56px; align-content: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); font-size: var(--text-row); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row small { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: var(--text-caption); font-weight: 400; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--line); } .ds-row--selected { margin: 0 -12px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-field); border-bottom-color: transparent; background: var(--selected-fill); }

components.name: Preview banner
components.description: Orange marker strip docked above the tab bar while a preview is on, with Hide and a dark capsule Exit.
components.html: Previewing Christmas 2026On this phone only
components.css: .ds-preview-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 8px 6px 20px; background: var(--marker); color: var(--on-marker); font-family: var(--font); font-size: var(--text-caption); box-shadow: 0 -0.5px 0 var(--line); } .ds-pb-text { flex: 1; display: grid; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-pb-hide { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pb-exit { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--on-marker); color: var(--marker); font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-pb-exit:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-preview-banner button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--on-marker); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Sunday Bulletin"**

The app reads like the church's own printed bulletin brought onto a phone. Every top-level tab opens on a navy masthead carrying a large title, a short line of context in beige, and the faint ring of the church's mark bleeding off the right edge; below it the page turns white and continues as a single readable column, with sand-coloured callouts where the bulletin would use a shaded box. On the long, sectioned pages (Sunday and Listen) a sticky row of section tabs sits under the masthead with an orange underline that slides to the section in view, so the page navigates like a folded bulletin rather than a dashboard.

Density is calm and generous: one column, a 20px gutter, list rows with hairline dividers instead of card stacks, and type sized off the iOS body text setting so the congregation's own Dynamic Type choice carries through. The system rejects the generic church-app tile grid and the feed of identical cards; content sits on the page, and cards appear only where a picture leads (an event, a sermon series).

Light is the default scheme. An app-wide dark scheme (night navy ground, raised navy surfaces, bright aqua, orange progress) is chosen in Appearance or follows the system. A second palette, the 2026 yearly theme (the website's greens and a serif masthead), is a full alternate. Which one everyone sees is data, not a release: staff choose it in Configuration's Colours area, optionally for a run of dates, and anyone who may make that choice can preview the other palette on their own phone first.

The admin panel is the same bulletin carried to the church office's desk. A persistent navy sidebar takes the masthead's place, the work area stays white, and a compact title band replaces the phone masthead. It opens on the office week: the next seven days as a sand rail of white day columns carrying what is dated, then what needs you and the areas you look after. Areas are worked as hairline tables with the chosen record's detail ruled off beside them. The panel follows the computer's light or dark setting.
keyCharacteristics: Navy masthead on every tab root, with the mark's ring echo at 7% opacity.
Sticky section tabs with a sliding orange underline on sectioned pages.
A navy top bar that is transparent over the masthead and turns solid once scrolled past it.
White page, sand callouts, hairline-divided rows; shadows only on the few boxed lists and picture cards.
Montserrat throughout at 400, 600 and 700; DM Serif Text only for yearly-theme mastheads.
rem type tied to the iOS body text size, so Dynamic Type scales the whole app.
In the admin panel, a 248px navy sidebar with beige group labels, an orange marker bar on the current page and orange count capsules, over a white work area that opens with a title band.

A tab bar built from what features register, ending in More; with the Hub home (favoured 2026-10-27) it grows to Home, Listen, Prayer, More. A notifications bell with an orange unread badge joins every tab root with the inbox.

rules.name: The Roles Not Hexes Rule
rules.body: Components use the semantic roles (masthead, primary, accent, live, marker, sand, ink, line) and never a palette hex, because every role is redefined by the scheme and the yearly theme. The only literal colours in components are the palette-picker swatches, the black video hero, and white on the play overlay.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Orange means "here" or "new": the active section, the unread item, how far you've listened. It is never a button fill and never decoration.

rules.name: The Aqua Acts Rule
rules.body: Aqua is for live state, for things you can act on (links, passages, the active tab), and for one short line of metadata at most (a series or recurrence line, a "Streamed on YouTube" tag). Navy is for the primary action itself. Don't use aqua for headings or running text.

rules.name: The Dynamic Type Rule
rules.body: Every font size is in rem off the iOS body root. Never set a font size in px; the only px type is the 17px root fallback for platforms without `-apple-system-body`.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Montserrat is the only face on the page. The serif belongs to the yearly palette's masthead title and nowhere else; the monospace belongs to raw permission nodes in the developer roles tool and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Times, durations, dates in the day rail and positions use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Sidebar Offset Rule
rules.body: Admin breakpoints are window media queries offset by the sidebar's 248px. Never make the work area a size container: it becomes the containing block for fixed elements and traps sheets and overlays inside it. A component may still use a container on its own inner list (as the split view does).

rules.name: The Masthead First Rule
rules.body: Every tab root and every settings page opens on a masthead with a title; long, sectioned pages add sticky section tabs under it. Detail pages with a picture lead with the picture instead (a 16:9 hero under a solid navy top bar). The admin panel has no masthead: its navy is the sidebar, and every page opens on a title band.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: No grids of tiles on a tab root. The only multi-column layouts are the two-up series grid on Listen and the day rail. On the desk the admin panel adds its shell, the day rail (a week or a fortnight) and the office week's two columns, split views, the workbench and the announcements desk's writing and proof columns, and still no grid of tool tiles.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Rows, callouts, the sermon head and the player sit flat on the page; only a boxed list or a picture card may lift. If something needs separating, give it sand, not a shadow. In the admin panel the only lifted things are the sign-in card, account panels and the workbench's settings panel; tables, the office week and the split view's detail are flat, separated by hairlines and sand, and today on the rail is an inset 2px primary ring, not a shadow. The chosen capsule on the rail, or the current "Not sent yet" chip, is a 2px marker outline at a 2px offset.

rules.name: The Tonal Selection Rule
rules.body: A selected row is marked by a fill one tonal step off its ground (Selected Fill, rounded to the field radius and widened 12px into the gutter on each side, its hairline hidden), never by a shadow or a border.

dos: **Do** open every tab root on a masthead with the title in display type, a beige note line and the mark at 7% opacity bleeding off the right edge.
**Do** add sticky section tabs with the sliding orange underline to any long page divided into named sections, and keep every tab label visible at 390pt width.
**Do** put the notifications bell in the top bar of every tab root.
**Do** build content as hairline-divided rows on the white page, and use sand (callouts, sermon head, player, fields) for anything the bulletin would shade.
**Do** size type in rem off the iOS body root and keep Montserrat at 400, 600 and 700.
**Do** read colours through the semantic roles so light, dark and the yearly palette all work without component overrides.
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px or more and give presses a scale and a haptic.
**Do** mark a selected row with Selected Fill, a tonal step, and nothing else.
**Do** open every admin page on a title band, and work an area as a data table with its detail in a split view beside it.
**Do** offset admin breakpoints by the 248px sidebar.
donts: **Don't** lay tab roots out as a grid of tiles or a feed of identical cards.
**Don't** float buttons over the reading column; actions belong in the top bar, in a section, or in a sheet.
**Don't** use orange as a button fill or decoration; it marks position and newness only.
**Don't** add shadows to rows, callouts or the player; only boxed lists and picture cards lift.
**Don't** use DM Serif Text anywhere but the yearly palette's masthead title.
**Don't** redraw or restyle the church mark beyond recolouring the supplied artwork.
**Don't** put a phone masthead in the admin panel, or open it on a grid of tool tiles.
**Don't** box the split view's detail as a card; it is a hairline-ruled column.
**Don't** make the admin work area a size container.
